name: Auto sort
description: Bank and card statements, bills and receipts, from wherever they arrive: uploads, the Send to Ledger browser extension, email, a scanner, a phone's camera or the Android app. Files wait in an inbox and are kept in Ledger's Documents; the AI suggests an account for each statement line and reads bills, and you approve everything before it is posted. Transfers are posted once, bills are tracked until paid. Needs an admin to allow it under Settings → LLM API.

tabs.label: Sorting
tabs.help: How the AI sorts statement lines into accounts.

tabs.label: Bills
tabs.help: What approving a bill does in the books.

tabs.label: Inbox
tabs.help: The inbox takes files from the browser extension, email, the scanner, a phone and uploads. Every file is kept in Ledger's Documents.

tabs.label: Email
tabs.help: Attachments of bill-like emails in Ledger's mailbox (Settings → Mail) are put in the inbox. An admin allows Auto sort to read mail there. Each organization has its own setting. Below: import a date range, leaving out what is already here.

tabs.label: Scanner
tabs.help: A scanner or printer on your network, for the Scan tab.

fields.label: Needs review below
fields.help: Confidence from 0 to 1. Suggestions the AI is less sure of are marked Needs review.

fields.label: Lines per AI request
fields.help: Smaller batches are slower but suit small models.

fields.label: Accounts payable
fields.help: Optional. Approving a bill posts it there, and its bank payment clears it. None: bills are only tracked.

fields.label: Remove sent and archived entries after (days)
fields.help: 0 keeps them. Files waiting in the inbox are never removed. A file that was sent on or filed stays in Documents.

fields.label: The check
fields.help: Only emails with one of the keywords are imported. What you delete with "Delete and learn" teaches it what to skip.

fields.label: Every (minutes)
fields.help: 0: only when you press Check email now.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.default: invoice, bill, statement, amount due, balance due, payment due, due date, receipt, pre-authorized, autopay, facture

fields.label: Save emails without attachments
fields.help: As .eml files, for bills sent as the email itself.

fields.label: Network scanner
fields.help: Easiest from the Scan tab (Find scanners). Or its address, e.g. 192.168.1.40: a scanner or printer with AirScan (eSCL) on your network.
